prompt:
You are an experienced sommelier comparing two wine recommenders. A
customer with no wine knowledge made this request:

"Hi, I am looking for a bottle of wine to drink tonight that tastes like red berries."

List A:
Wine 1: Bordeaux-style Red Blend, France, $20. Tasting note: "A ripe, juicy and smoky wine that is already attractive to drink. It has soft tannins, ripe red berries with acidity and black currants at the end. Drink this fine wine from 2020."
Wine 2: Pinot Noir, France, $23. Tasting note: "This is a fruity, lightly structured wine. With perfumed red berries and tight acidity, it is all about fruitiness and freshness. It needs to fill out and to become as rich as its potential suggests. Drink from 2018."
Wine 3: Portuguese Red, Portugal, $9. Tasting note: "This is a full, fruity, rich and concentrated wine. It has bright red berries, some firm tannins and a good dense texture. It's also light and crisp, with acidity that cuts through the ripe fruitiness. Drink now through 2019."
Wine 4: Pinot Noir, France, $35. Tasting note: "This wine offers red berry fruits, the softest tannins and texture and an earthy, rustic aftertaste. Drink now."
Wine 5: Syrah, US, $38. Tasting note: "This is a soft, richly attractive red wine to drink now. It shows elaborate blackberry, cherry, currant, teriyaki beef, black pepper, anise and sandalwood flavors. An elegant mouthfeel, grows better as it breathes in the glass."

List B:
Wine 1: Portuguese Red, Portugal, $10. Tasting note: "A wine for early drinking, this is soft, fruity and bright. With red berry flavor and gentle tannins, it's direct and packed with fruitiness. Drink now."
Wine 2: Champagne Blend, France, $200. Tasting note: "A soft wine with flavors of red berries, canned strawberries and a structure that seems more red wine than Champagne. It's a curious hybrid, starting with too much tannin and leaving some astringency. Maybe bottle age will help."
Wine 3: Portuguese Red, Portugal, $14. Tasting note: "Red fruits dominate this wine that is ready to drink. It has berry flavors, generous tannins and sweetness at the end. Drink this attractive wine from late 2017."
Wine 4: Portuguese Red, Portugal, $7. Tasting note: "Made to be drunk young, this is a fruity red berry flavored wine. It has a bright crisp edge to its fruit as well as light tannins and acidity. It is quite ready to drink."
Wine 5: Portuguese Red, Portugal, $25. Tasting note: "Full of red fruits and generous tannins, this is an immediately attractive wine. The red-berry fruits are balanced by good acidity and a crisp aftertaste. Drink from 2017 to allow the tannins to soften further."

Which list answers the request better as a whole: relevance to every wish,
variety where the request leaves room, and fit for any occasion? If they
are equally good, say tie. Think briefly, then answer with JSON only:
{"reason": "<two sentences at most>", "better": "A" | "B" | "tie"}
